profile.headline: Software Engineer | C++ | OOD/OOP | C# | Team Lead | MS Windows | Linux | Multi-Tasked, Multi-Threaded Systems
profile.summary:
Experienced software engineer interested in helping develop innovative software solutions to real-world problems in the areas of engineering or scientific applications.  My skill areas include object-oriented programming using C++, C#, C and other programming languages in Windows and Linux environments.  
    
I have managed teams of software developers in several industries including gaming, information technology and services, and semiconductors.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Tortoise SVN · Agile Methodologies · C++ · Git · Linux · .NET · Software Development · Software Engineering · Visual Studio

positions.title: Senior Advanced Software Engineer
positions.description:
Member of a team that developed and tested a network emulator used to interface with various avionics networks and used to simulate devices on those networks. I was responsible for developing Python test scripts that were used to functionally test various features of the network emulator. The networks that were interfaced with included MIL-STD-1553B, Ethernet 1553, and digital I/O. I was also responsible for testing releases of the network emulator. The emulator operated on a Microsoft Windows platform.

For hardware programming and testing for the 1553B and digital I/O interfaces, the team and I used United Electronic Industries (UEI) hardware and software including PowerDNA Explorer. I was also on the team responsible for developing and reviewing requirements for the network emulator.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed, implemented, and tested software to simulate aircraft systems for full flight simulators that are used to train aircraft pilots. These aircraft systems included but were not limited to electrical, fuel, ice protection, and autoflight systems. This software was implemented in C++ and C in proprietary multi-tasked environments on Linux engineering workstations.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Software Engineer for a manufacturer of computer imaged instant lottery tickets. Designed, implemented, and tested software used to verify and validate highly accurate and secure data used to print instant lottery tickets. This software was implemented in Fortran and C# on MS Windows.

positions.title: Programming Manager
positions.description: Supervisor, project manager, and programmer for the software department of a manufacturer of computer imaged instant lottery tickets and other promotional material. This department generated, verified, and validated highly accurate and secure data used to print instant lottery tickets. The software department also created the layout used to print instant lottery tickets using specialized commercial variable data document preparation software and merged the ticket data into this layout.

positions.title: Director of Engineering
positions.description: Supervisor and member of a team that designed, implemented, and supported software systems that provided voice access to the Internet and other data sources using the telephone and other devices.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Member of a team that maintained, implemented and tested a new version of a system of Tcl/Tk/Oracle database and GUI applications used by DOD for joint operational planning and execution.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Member of a team that designed, implemented, and integrated several multi-tasked, multi-threaded, distributed software systems which implement DSP applications on embedded platforms using DSP data-flow techniques.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Technical lead for integration of software systems onto 2 Army surveillance vehicles.

positions.title: Scientific Programmer
positions.description: Project leader and programmer on circuit analysis project. Developed and supported TI's version of SPICE2, an integrated circuit simulation program implemented in Fortran.
